module_summary: GMII/MII-to-AXI-Stream receiver: a five-stage byte delay line (with MII nibble assembly) feeds a 3-state FSM that strips preamble and checks CRC32 FCS via an LFSR.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/WAIT_LAST receive FSM driving AXI output and CRC control

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive byte (or MII nibble) input into delay line

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: Receive data valid; frames packet and signals end of frame

anchors.name: gmii_rx_er
anchors.why: Receive error input delayed to flag bad frames

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream output byte

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid during PAYLOAD

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Last byte marker at end of frame or error

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bad-frame flag plus optional timestamp

anchors.name: gmii_rxd_d4
anchors.why: Last delay-line stage; checked for SFD, fed to CRC and output

anchors.name: gmii_rxd_d0
anchors.why: First delay stage, assembles MII nibbles; part of FCS compare window

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv_d4
anchors.why: Delayed data valid aligned to d4 byte for start detection

anchors.name: gmii_rx_er_d4
anchors.why: Delayed error aligned to output byte; aborts frame

anchors.name: mii_odd
anchors.why: MII nibble phase toggle; gates FSM and delay-line shifts every other cycle

anchors.name: in_frame
anchors.why: Tracks frame presence after SFD; triggers start_packet

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 state, reset in IDLE and updated in PAYLOAD

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: LFSR output compared to received FCS bytes

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: Reinitialises CRC in IDLE

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances CRC during PAYLOAD

anchors.name: clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable holding FSM and delay line when low

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables acceptance of new frames in IDLE

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse on errored or bad-FCS frame

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse on FCS mismatch

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-frame pulse after SFD detection

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: PTP timestamp captured at frame start for tuser

groups.name: Receive FSM
groups.description: Detects SFD, forwards payload, checks FCS and errors

groups.name: Input delay line
groups.description: Five-stage data/dv/er delay holding FCS window for comparison

groups.name: MII adapter
groups.description: Nibble phase and frame tracking for MII/GMII clock-enable operation

groups.name: AXI stream output
groups.description: Registered AXI-Stream byte output with last and user

groups.name: Status and PTP
groups.description: Error/start status pulses and timestamp capture
